propositions: file_impact field is currently two-valued (populated or empty), causing empty to conflate 'author forgot' with 'genuinely no files touched'
empty file_impact triggers whole-HEAD fallback in dependency_hashes and compute_validity, invalidating attestation on any repository commit
a non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons a container's inherited drift scope via _inherited_child_impact, collapsing siblings' declarations to whole-HEAD
the fix introduces tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared/paths/none) with required no_file_impact_reason for the none state
explicit 'none' declaration enters the material fingerprint and signed manifest, enabling precision scoping; undeclared retains conservative whole-HEAD behavior
a plan-review criterion judges the truthfulness of the no-file-impact assertion against the plan, triggered only when the declaration is present
